growth.name: Max Growth
growth.description: Targets the highest expected return using a max-Sharpe allocation across high-quality growth equities from the Aurum universe.

shield.name: Min Risk
shield.description: Targets the minimum-variance point on the efficient frontier using defensive equities across utilities, consumer staples, and health care.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.description: A diversified portfolio spanning all GICS sectors, capped at 25% per sector, optimised for the best risk-adjusted return.

accessible.name: Accessible
accessible.tagline: Growth portfolio with budget-friendly price points
accessible.description: Max-Sharpe growth portfolio restricted to equities priced at or below $150, making it accessible for smaller investment budgets.

tech-ai.name: Tech & AI
tech-ai.tagline: Concentrated bet on technology and artificial intelligence
tech-ai.description: Concentrated max-Sharpe allocation across Information Technology and Communication Services — the epicentre of AI-driven growth.

healthcare.name: Healthcare
healthcare.tagline: Healthcare and biotech with defensive characteristics
healthcare.description: Max-Sharpe portfolio concentrated in Health Care — pharmaceuticals, biotech, and medical devices — blending growth with defensive income.

energy-infra.name: Energy & Infrastructure
energy-infra.tagline: Real-asset exposure across energy and infrastructure
energy-infra.description: Max-Sharpe allocation across Energy, Utilities, and Industrials — capturing infrastructure spending and the energy-transition tailwind.

consumer.name: Consumer Blend
consumer.description: Holds the world's strongest consumer brands across discretionary and staples — combining defensive dividend payers with higher-growth retail and food-service names. Relatively low volatility for a growth-leaning allocation.

dividend.name: Dividend Income
dividend.description: Min-variance portfolio screened across traditionally high-dividend-paying GICS sectors: Staples, Utilities, Energy, Comms, Health Care, and Financials.

global-div.name: Global Diversified
global-div.tagline: Globally diversified portfolio with ≥40% non-US exposure
global-div.description: Max-Sharpe broad portfolio biased toward international equities. Iterates until at least 40% of portfolio weight comes from non-US tickers.

quality.name: Quality Blue-Chip
quality.tagline: Mega-cap quality names across all sectors
quality.description: Max-Sharpe portfolio restricted to mega-cap equities across all sectors, capped at 20% per sector for broad blue-chip diversification.

value.name: Value
value.tagline: Classic value sectors with min-variance discipline
value.description: Min-variance portfolio across value-oriented GICS sectors — Financials, Energy, Consumer Staples, Utilities, and Materials — tilted toward large and mid caps.
